parameters.query:
SELECT
  pv.id::int AS "id",
  pv.parqueadero_usuario_id::int AS "parkingUserId",
  UPPER(pv.placa) AS "plate",
  pv.tipo_vehiculo AS "type",
  COALESCE(pv.marca, '') AS "brand",
  COALESCE(pv.modelo, '') AS "model",
  COALESCE(pv.color, '') AS "color",
  pv.es_principal AS "isPrimary",
  pv.activo AS "active"
FROM public.parqueadero_vehiculos pv
WHERE pv.activo = TRUE
ORDER BY pv.es_principal DESC, UPPER(pv.placa), pv.id;
